Maya (Growth): Quick huddle — final copy sweep for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Goal: clear differentiation, short benchmark line on Hosted, webinar CTA for Private. Can we finish today? cc @Samir @Leah
Samir (Product): Draft headline ideas: Hosted: 'Ship features, not infra.' Subhead: 'Hosted API — low-latency generation, streaming, and observability.' Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput for mission-critical apps.' Subhead: 'Reserved GPU pools, autoscaling, SLA-backed latency targets.' Private: 'Bring inference behind your VPC.' Subhead: 'Private control plane, KMS, and air-gapped options.'
Leah (Design): Keep hero short and visual. Three-column on desktop; accordion mobile. No long lines in hero.
Marina (Content): For Hosted benchmark phrasing — legal wants conservative language. Proposal: '~100 ms p95 on typical generation workloads (see methodology)'. Also add link to /benchmarks.
Chris (Eng): Agreed. I'll prepare a short methodology note so we can link it. Avoid exact bold numbers. Also add fallback language: 'automatic routing to compatible model variants to preserve latency and cost'.
Noah (Sales): Routing note: Private leads should go to enterprise-sales@ with form fields: compliance checklist, desired throughput, cloud region, and ARR band. Add hidden utm_campaign=private_launch.
Maya (Growth): CTA suggestions? Hosted: 'Try Hosted API' Dedicated: 'Reserve Capacity' Private: 'Request Private' 
Samir (Product): Add small supporting bullets under each hero for conversion: Hosted: streaming, SDKs, pay-per-token. Dedicated: commit pricing, burst capacity, predictable SLAs. Private: VPC, KMS, on-prem option + security review/webinar.
Marina (Content): I'll write a 2-sentence benchmark blurb for Hosted page: 'Benchmarked for production: typical p95 latency ~100 ms on common generation prompts. See our benchmark appendix for datasets and configs.'
Leah (Design): Once copy is staged I'll add annotations for responsive truncation and CTA placement.
Maya (Growth): @deploy-bot spin a staging preview with these hero lines so we can review visuals.
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for site copy. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/1769012345-landing-copy
Noah (Sales): I'll configure HubSpot mapping and share the form mapping doc here when ready. Will ensure Private page triggers enterprise-sales routing.
Marina (Content): Draft webinar blurb for Private CTA: 'Launch webinar: Deploying inference securely — architecture, compliance, and cost tradeoffs. Sign up to get the slides and checklist.'
Chris (Eng): If legal wants supporting material for the benchmark we can provide benchmark scripts and a short appendix describing hardware, model, and request templates.
Maya (Growth): Timeline: 1) stage preview, 2) internal review + legal on benchmark line, 3) HubSpot routing + form fields live, 4) webinar signup linked from Private CTA. Target: EOD.
Samir (Product): Minor copy tweak: change Hosted subhead to include 'benchmarked performance' instead of 'benchmarked' as a separate sentence. Marina to update.
Marina (Content): Updated live in thread: Hosted subhead: 'Hosted API — low-latency generation, streaming, built-in observability, and benchmarked performance.' Dedicated subhead: 'Reserved GPU capacity with autoscaling, commit pricing, and SLA-backed latency targets.' Private subhead: 'Private control plane with KMS integrations, air-gapped options, and security review/webinar.'
Leah (Design): I'll drop comps and mobile variants into the PR once preview link is live.
Maya (Growth): Thanks all — paste any last microcopy edits here. I'll post the staging link to #marketing when the preview is up. :rocket:
